quotes.verbatim_quote: Some jazz improvisers bring some of the be-bop vocabulary with them when playing on modal pieces.
the third of the G minor chord is approached by its leading tone. The F# and A encircle the root. E natural implies C7 and is approached from above and below.
outline no.1 can be clearly heard on the downbeats; leading tones have been added giving the line more of a sawtooth shape.

quotes.topic: CESH outline no.3 in modal blues
quotes.verbatim_quote: Cannonball Adderley uses this C.E.S.H. version of outline no.3 several times in the solo to contrast with his modal, motivic, and down and dirty blues playing on this modal blues tune.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Strategic outline use in modal solo.
